## Vera 05 · 00 Errors and stuck messages
Catch-all for every Desk 05 workflow. Logs the failure, emails Vera ops (a different channel from WhatsApp, so a WhatsApp outage cannot hide itself), and every 10 minutes sends messages stuck in "processing" to the review queue.

Generated from `n8n/mobilise/workflows.mjs`. Edit there and rebuild; edits made here are overwritten on the next import.
Each node's note says what it does and which guardrails it carries.

nodes.name: When any workflow fails
nodes.notes: Set as the error workflow on WF-01 to WF-09.

nodes.name: Describe the failure
nodes.notes: Workflow, node, error, link. No message contents, no secrets.

nodes.name: Log the error

parameters.query: insert into errors (workflow, execution_id, node, message, url) values ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5) returning id;

nodes.notes:
Kept even if email fails.
Guardrails: audit

nodes.name: Email Vera ops
nodes.notes:
Email, not WhatsApp: a WhatsApp outage must not hide its own alert.
Guardrails: retry

nodes.name: Messages stuck in processing
nodes.notes:
A crash between nodes still ends with a person looking at the message.
Guardrails: human
